notes: Each .md is input; .html is render(input) and .txt is plain(input), ignoring the golden output file final LF. The same grammar applies to posts and comments. Known sticker catalog: pixelpepe/happy = Happy Pepe, Pixel Pepe. Internal pipeline references use the specified HTTP/S origin. Authored relative links stay literal. No H1, tables, images, raw HTML, entity decoding, or more than one nested list. Empty and CRLF cases are exercised in the test runner.
